terra.problem: The text says Paul looked directly at the Sanhedrin, not that the whole Sanhedrin was staring at him.
The text does not identify those standing near Paul as men.
The commander's Roman citizenship is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The description of a centurion as a Roman officer and the identification of Ananias as the council's leader go beyond this passage and need support.
The passage says some scribes from the Pharisees defend Paul; it does not say that the Pharisees as a whole are not against him.
The passage says the commander ordered the soldiers to bring Paul into the barracks. It does not explicitly say they brought him there.

The passage reports an order to bring Paul into the barracks, not his arrival. It also says the commander feared Paul would be torn to pieces, not that he wanted Paul out before the dispute got worse.
